description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Use when someone asks about typical rents or house prices around a postcode in England. Returns the ONS average monthly private rent for the local authority (with bedroom breakdown and annual change) and the HM Land Registry median sale price and number of sales for the postcode district, from a dated snapshot. Each figure carries its source, release and obtained dates, period and the required attribution. Read-only. Area figures only, never a valuation of one home. Information, not financial advice.

postcode.description: Full postcode in England, at most 16 characters, e.g. SE15 5BA

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.
